title: 第679章 这特么还带感染的第678章 想要追赶上夫君
slug: 人在废丹房我以丹药证道成仙
content_zh:
第679章这特么还带感染的？
不多时，他便来到红仙儿的书房之中。
这会的红仙儿，似乎还正在处理着什么事情。
她望着面前之人，一脸认真的交代道。
“究竟是谁送来的，务必要查清楚。”
“遵命，圣主大人，我们一定将其找出来！”
“注意别太唐突，毕竟是对我们圣地有恩之人。”
“属下明白。”
那人应了一声，接着注意到附近的叶云，立马懂事的行了一礼道。
“既如此，属下就先行告退了。”
这时候，红仙儿也注意到叶云。
故而，她点了下头道。
“行，你下去吧。”
待到那长老告辞离去，不忘对叶云躬身行了一礼。
“见过叶长老。”
如今在古道圣地，见到叶云无需行礼之人，可着实不多了。
绝大多数的长老，弟子，见到他几乎都得恭敬的行上一礼。
叶云点头致意，与这长老错身而过，来到红仙儿面前笑道。
“娘子，几日不见，想我了没有？”
闻言，红仙儿盯着他问道。

“你这几天闭关去了？”
“这不仙儿你又不让我出去，恰好这两天，我突有所悟，便去闭关了下。”
叶云咧嘴一笑，一脸认真的说道。
见此，红仙儿若有所思的点了下头。
“是这样啊，我还以为，你是偷偷跑出去了呢。”
“啊这……怎么可能！”
叶云深吸口气，一本正经的道。
“我这个人，最有信誉了！”
“既然答应过仙儿不出去，那就绝不会出去！”
当然，他这就纯属在胡诌了。
反正撒谎也不需要交税。
红仙儿柳眉微动，点了下头道。
“嗯……没出去就好。”
叶云意识到，这话题不宜深聊，免得露馅了。
当即，他轻咳一声，将话题给转移开来。
“我说仙儿，咱们还是先聊聊正事吧。”
叶云望着红仙儿，认真的问道。
“听轻烟说，你有事情找我，让我出关后立马来一趟？”

Chapter 679 Is this even infected?
Not long after, he came to Hong Xian'er's study.
At this moment, Hong Xian'er seemed to be dealing with something.
She looked at the person in front of her and explained with a serious face.
"It's important to find out who sent it."
"As you command, Lord Holy Lord, we will definitely find him!"
"Be careful not to be too abrupt. After all, he is a person who is kind to our Holy Land."
"My subordinate understands."
The man responded, then noticed Ye Yun nearby, and immediately saluted sensibly.
"In this case, I will take my leave first."
At this time, Hong Xian'er also noticed Ye Yun.
Therefore, she nodded and said.
"Okay, you go down."
When the elder said goodbye and left, he did not forget to bow to Ye Yun.
"I've met Elder Ye."
Nowadays, in the ancient holy land, there are not many people who don't need to bow when they see Ye Yun.
Most of the elders and disciples almost bowed respectfully when they saw him.
Ye Yun nodded in greeting, passed by the elder, came to Hong Xian'er and smiled.
"Madam, I haven't seen you for a few days. Do you miss me?"
Hearing this, Hong Xian'er stared at him and asked.
"Have you been in seclusion these days?"
"You're not a fairy, you won't let me go out. Just in the past two days, I suddenly realized something, so I went to retreat for a while."
Ye Yun grinned and said seriously.
Seeing this, Hong Xian'er nodded thoughtfully.
"That's right. I thought you ran out secretly."
"Ah... how is this possible!"
Ye Yun took a deep breath and said seriously.
"I am the most reputable person!"
"Since I promised Xian'er not to go out, I will never go out!"
Of course, he was just talking nonsense.
You don’t need to pay taxes if you lie anyway.
Hong Xian'er's eyebrows moved slightly and she nodded.
"Well...it's okay if you don't go out."
Ye Yun realized that this topic should not be discussed in depth, lest the secret be exposed.
Immediately, he coughed slightly and changed the topic.
"Xian'er, let's talk about business first."
Ye Yun looked at Hong Xian'er and asked seriously.
"I heard from Qing Yan, if you have something to ask me about, do you want me to come over immediately after I leave the border?"
